custom_reports.description: Allows users to define reports with custom groupBy dimensions.

base_report_type.description: The base report type. It determines the set of available dimensions for the `groupBy` field and the metrics that will be included in the custom report. Only one value is supported: `CAMPAIGN`.

group_by.description: The list of dimensions to group the data by. The available dimensions depend on the selected `baseReportType`.

table.description: The name of the custom report table. It must be unique within this connection and must comply with Fivetran's naming conventions.

items.description: Allows users to define reports with custom groupBy dimensions.

show_records_with_no_metrics.description: Turn the toggle on if you want the reports to also return records without metrics.

timeframe_months.description:
Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once connection is created.
NOTE: The more months of reporting data you sync, the longer your initial sync will take.

timezone_mode.description: Determines whether to use UTC or the users timezone from the apple account

client_id.description: Apple Search Ads REST API Client ID. Must be populated if `is_auth2_enabled` is set to `true`.

key_id.description: Apple Search Ads REST API Key ID. Must be populated if `is_auth2_enabled` is set to `true`.

team_id.description: Apple Search Ads REST API Team ID. Must be populated if `is_auth2_enabled` is set to `true`.
